text:
tom.sales: AuroraHealth RFP just arrived. They asked for a capability matrix, security questionnaire answers, and a tight 4-week POC plan. Must-haves: dedicated capacity, customer-managed KMS/HSM, EU data residency (eu-west-1). PDF attached.

rachel-se: Thanks. Do we have their expected concurrency / avg tokens? that'll drive the dedicated sizing and perf notes.

tom.sales: They listed ~220 concurrent sessions peak, avg prompt 75 tokens, avg response 180 tokens. Target latency: p50 <= 250ms, p95 <= 600ms. They want per-token cost reporting during POC and audit log export.

rachel-se: Baseline rec: 2x A100-class GPUs for steady load, autoscale to 4 for spikes. Air-gapped appliance will need higher spec to reliably hit p95. I'll draft the capability matrix and call out performance risk for air-gapped.

kat-ops: Deployment options: they checked both "private VPC" and "air-gapped appliance." We'll need two runbooks: VPC-connected private control plane + offline appliance image with manual key injection. Also include teardown + data-destruction checklist and SHA256 manifest template.

checker-bot: Compliance snapshot: SOC2-TypeII=YES, ISO27001=PARTIAL, FEDRAMP=NO, KMS-INTEGRATION=SUPPORTED, HSM-ATTESTATION=PARTNER-CERTS-AVAILABLE. See /sales/rfps/templates.

leo-csm: We should lock acceptance criteria before the POC starts: throughput/latency tests, a KMS key-rotation demo, and audit log export verification. I'll ask their PM to provide a written success checklist.

nina-legal: We'll need the DPA and an addendum for customer-managed HSM duties. Also clarify if they require subprocessor disclosures and HSM attestation language. I'll draft a redline.

rachel-se: Quick CSV snippet for the RFP matrix to include (conservative numbers):
```
feature,hosted,dedicated,private-vpc,air-gapped
concurrent-sessions,1200,3000,220,220
p50-latency,100ms,85ms,150ms,210ms
p95-latency,420ms,300ms,580ms,820ms
kms-mode,managed,customer-managed,connector,hsm-offline
data-residency,global,region-pinned,region-pinned,onsite-only
per-token-reporting,yes,yes,yes,limited-offline
```

tom.sales: Good. Tasks: Rachel -> expand matrix into table and a 2-page POC runbook (install steps, smoke/perf tests, billing hooks). Kat -> teardown + SHA256 manifest + offline metrics export steps. Nina -> DPA redline. Leo -> confirm acceptance criteria with customer and capture in writing. I'll schedule a kickoff call Wed 09:00 UTC.

rachel-se: ETA for matrix + runbook: EOD tomorrow. Note: if AuroraHealth insists on p95 < 500ms in air-gapped mode we should propose a heavier hardware spec or a relaxed p95 target. I'll explicitly call that out.

kat-ops: Flag: FIPS-only or strict crypto on appliance adds ~10 business days for secure build and approval. If egress is blocked, auto-updates and telemetry won't work; provide manual patch & offline export guidance.

nina-legal: Adding a clause to the DPA draft to cover HSM custody responsibilities and a post-POC zeroization attestation. Also propose a subprocessor list disclosure window.

leo-csm: I'll push for written acceptance criteria during the kickoff. If they want per-token billing during the POC, ask them to confirm the billing hook format (CSV or API).

tom.sales: Uploaded AuroraHealth_RFP_v1.pdf and their security questionnaire. Please review attachments before Wed. Flag blockers now. :thumbsup:
